newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor delays U.S. listing decision.
newsitem.headline: Investor delays U.S. listing decision.

text.p: Swedish industrial investment company Investor AB on Monday said it had delayed for some years a decision on whether or not to seek a listing in New York.
"During the autumn we investigated whether it was appropriate to introduce Investor AB also on the bourse in New York," the company's managing director Claes Dahlback said in a statement.
Dahlback said: "After listening to our advisors we realised that the present moment was not the best.
"For this reason we will review this issue again in some years time."
He said that Investor would continue to build up investor relations in the U.S.
"To get the best effect of a listing it is important to be well known in the market," he said.
